rationale: Positives: The agent verified identity correctly using name + zip, looked up the user and order, and identified valid replacement variants. Negatives (policy breaches): 1) The agent executed an order‐changing write (exchange) without first stating the exact changes and obtaining explicit confirmation to proceed; the user only confirmed variant choices, not authorization to submit the exchange and charge the payment method. 2) The agent unilaterally used the stored PayPal method for any price difference without explicit confirmation. 3) When the user asked to hold off on the water bottle, the agent asserted the exchange could not be changed or canceled without checking or citing tool evidence. 4) Some option availability communication was inconsistent (listing variants without clearly marking unavailability). Given the required pre‐write confirmation and correct final information standards, this fails the pass bar.
